suite: Static natural-language intent-routing contracts; real model selection remains Human QA.

cases.name: exact system search
cases.prompt: 搜索 Jita。
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve Jita once and report the returned match without changing the map.

cases.name: abbreviated system search
cases.prompt: 帮我找 1DQ1-A。
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve the supplied text through MCP rather than guessing a system ID.

cases.name: ambiguous system search
cases.prompt: 帮我找 1DQ。
cases.expectedBehavior: If multiple plausible candidates are returned, list concise candidates and ask the user to choose before continuing.

cases.name: system details
cases.prompt: Jita 的安全等级、区域和星门数是多少？
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve once, then read details from the map instead of EVE background knowledge.

cases.name: explicit map focus
cases.prompt: 在地图上定位到 Jita。
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve and focus the viewport because the user explicitly requested map location.

cases.name: unqualified route defaults normal
cases.prompt: Jita 到 Amarr 怎么走？
cases.expectedBehavior: Treat the unqualified query as normal query-only routing with useAnsiblex=false.

cases.name: query-only normal route
cases.prompt: 算一下 Jita 到 Amarr 的普通路线和跳数，不要显示。
cases.expectedBehavior: Return the calculation without creating map state.

cases.name: query normal route with ansiblex
cases.prompt: 算 Jita 到 Amarr 的普通路线，允许 Ansiblex。
cases.expectedBehavior: Calculate a normal route with useAnsiblex=true and no display mutation.

cases.name: visual normal mission
cases.prompt: 把 Jita 到 Amarr 的普通路线画在地图上。
cases.expectedBehavior: Create only the needed temporary Mission and display one normal route.

cases.name: capital route missing range
cases.prompt: 算一下 Jita 到 Amarr 的旗舰跳跃路线。
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask for the effective jump range in LY before calling a capital-route tool.

cases.name: query-only capital route
cases.prompt: 按 6 LY 算 Jita 到 Amarr 的旗舰路线，不要显示。
cases.expectedBehavior: Calculate the explicit-range capital route without changing the map.

cases.name: visual capital mission
cases.prompt: 按 6 LY 把 Jita 到 Amarr 的旗舰路线显示在地图上。
cases.expectedBehavior: Display one explicit-range capital route in a temporary Mission.

cases.name: current AI mission routes
cases.prompt: 地图现在有什么 AI 路线？
cases.expectedBehavior: Inspect active Missions and their routes; clearly scope the answer to AI-owned Mission state.

cases.name: current selected system unsupported
cases.prompt: 查一下当前选中的星系。
cases.expectedBehavior: Explain that current selection is not exposed by the available tools and ask the user to name the system; never guess.

cases.name: marker read
cases.prompt: 1DQ 上现在有什么标记？
cases.expectedBehavior: Distinguish persistent Saved Marker state from session-only Mission Markers.

cases.name: temporary marker default
cases.prompt: 在 1DQ 做个红色危险标记。
cases.expectedBehavior: Create a temporary red DANGER Mission Marker, not persistent state.

cases.name: ambiguous remember stays temporary
cases.prompt: 记住这个星系很危险。
cases.expectedBehavior: When the system is already resolved in conversation, treat remember wording as a temporary Mission Marker.

cases.name: explicit permanent marker
cases.prompt: 把 1DQ 永久保存为危险点，并加 DANGER 标签。
cases.expectedBehavior: Create one persistent Saved Marker with initial DANGER tag and explicit persistence intent.

cases.name: saved marker no implicit tags
cases.prompt: 永久保存 Jita。
cases.expectedBehavior: Create with no inferred tags and default YELLOW when no color is supplied.

cases.name: saved marker permission denied
cases.prompt: 永久保存 Jita，但 Saved Marker Access 已关闭。
cases.expectedBehavior: Report that no persistent marker was created and do not silently create a temporary marker.

cases.name: saved marker duplicate
cases.prompt: 这个星系已经有 Saved Marker，再永久保存一次并加 HOME 标签。
cases.expectedBehavior: Report that the existing marker and its tags were unchanged.

cases.name: saved marker mutation protection
cases.prompt: 删除我的 Saved Marker，然后换一组标签。
cases.expectedBehavior: Explain that existing Saved Marker update, delete, replace, and tag mutation are unavailable.

cases.name: map offline
cases.prompt: 地图没启动，帮我搜索 Jita。
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask the user to start EVE Static Map Planner and enable AI Control, without PATH, PowerShell, or MCP setup instructions.

cases.name: app disconnected error
cases.prompt: 搜索 Jita。
cases.expectedBehavior: Report that the map has no AI Control session and do not use an alternate control path.

cases.name: route tool error
cases.prompt: Jita 到 Amarr 怎么走？
cases.expectedBehavior: Report the route failure truthfully, do not fabricate a route, and do not mutate the map.

cases.name: narrow route removal
cases.prompt: 删掉这个 AI Mission 里的这条路线。
cases.expectedBehavior: Inspect for the opaque route ID when needed and remove only the requested Mission route.

cases.name: mission fit only when requested
cases.prompt: 把 Delve Move 整个任务适配到视图。
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve the existing Mission and fit only because the user explicitly requested it.

cases.name: list all views
cases.prompt: 我现在有哪些 View？
cases.expectedBehavior: List labels and stable identities without changing the current View.

cases.name: current view
cases.prompt: 地图当前显示哪个 View？
cases.expectedBehavior: Read and report the current View without changing it.

cases.name: named view mission
cases.prompt: 在 Scout View 里把 Jita 到 Amarr 画出来。
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve Scout by unique label, pass its stable viewId to begin_mission, and do not switch the UI.

cases.name: create unique view
cases.prompt: 新建一个叫 Scout 的 View。
cases.expectedBehavior: Create the explicitly requested View; report a duplicate-label error without inventing a different name.

cases.name: rename named view
cases.prompt: 把 Scout View 改名成 Forward Scout。
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve the old label, then rename by stable viewId while preserving View identity.

cases.name: delete named view
cases.prompt: 删除 Forward Scout View。
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve and delete only that View, respecting the last-View protection.
